Cloud Forest Hotel | Mount Totumas | Panama
top of page
Located at 1900m Mount Totumas Cloud Forest is a resort located on a 400 acre reserve that directly borders La Amistad National Park, Central America's largest highland preserved wilderness. Panama's spectacular cloud forest is at the doorstep of your accommodations and the trails provide guests access to the many endemic and keystone species of flora and fauna of this increasingly endangered habitat. The resort offers superlative accommodations, excellent farm to table cuisine, well maintained marked trails and experienced guides.

FAQ | Mount Totumas
top of page
Frequently Asked Questions
We understand that traveling to a remote location such as Mount Totumas Cloud Forest (MTCF) can sometimes spark many questions!
We created this document to help you plan your trip as best possible.
TRANSPORTATION
​
You will need a 4x4 high clearance vehicle to make it up to MTCF (no exceptions)! We can arrange a 4x4 transportation service for you to and from the closest airport (David). Please see further details below:
How much does private 4x4 transportation cost? (rates are per trip not per person)
Volcan Mount Totumas $60 / Travel time is 1 hour
David Mount Totumas $100 / Travel time is 2 hours
Mount Totumas Boquete $100 / Travel time is 2 hours.
How do I reserve private 4x4 transportation to and from MTCF?
Via Whatsapp +507 69 63 50 69
Which high clearance 4x4 can make it up the public 4x4 road.
Toyota Prado, Fortuner, Hilux, Nissan Frontier, Suzuki Jimmy
Not recommended: AWD Toyota Rav 4 as well as Hyundai and Kia models are too low clearance.
​
​
DIRECTIONS
​
Driving directions from Volcan
A 4WD vehicle is required to visit Mount Totumas Cloud Forest. Set your odometer to zero at Banco Nacional in Volcan. Take the paved road to Rio Sereno for approx. 9.8km to a pass called Silla Pando. You will round a curve and notice on your right a turn off that starts as paved for about 20 feet and then terminates as a 4x4 track. This turn off is before the small bus stop. This is the beginning of the 4WD road up to Mount Totumas. Set your odometer again to zero and continue slowly up the road. At around km 5 you will see a sign Los Pozos and Mount Totumas. Continue straight on the road for about 2km when you drive across the first stream. Continue up to an open area with rustic cabins. You will see on your left a small road leading up with a sign for Mount Totumas. Follow this and when you cross the 2nd stream you're on our reserve. From here it is an additional 2km- then your here
​
Traveling to Mount Totumas from Panama City
There are two airlines that offer domestic flight service from Panama City to David (closest airport to MTCF). Copa Airlines has two flights a day and they leave from the International Airport at Tocumen. Air Panama also has two flights a day and they leave from the domestic airport in Albrook close to the center of the city. Both airlines charge about the same and there is no savings in getting a round trip flight.
If you are planning on staying a couple days in Panama City before heading to David then the best choice is to fly with Air Panama from Albrook domestic airport. If you are arriving on an international flight and want to come directly to David then choose Copa Airlines as you can often connect on your arrival day to a flight to David If your international flight arrives in the evening there are two hotels that are 3 minutes from Tocumen that offer free shuttles, Riande Hotel and Crown Plaza Tocumen. You can catch the first flight to David the following morning.
Once again consider either airline when returning from David to Panama City. If you are connecting to an international flight then choose Copa Airlines. If you are planning to stay a night or two in Panama City before departing Panama then choose Air Panama.
​
COMMUNICATION
​
Phone service is poor due to our remote location. However we have high speed internet so the best way to communicate with us is through Whatsapp at +507 69 63 50 69
FOOD/ MEALS
We do not have an a la carte menu at Mount Totumas. We do fixed meals daily and you only need to let us know of any dietary restrictions or preferences.
Breakfast everyday is at 7am. A typical breakfast consists of options such as eggs, oatmeal, fresh fruit & pastries. Lunch (12:00pm) & Dinner (7pm) is a set menu (often 2 choices) with protein or vegetarian friendly options.
How much do breakfast, lunch & dinner cost?
Breakfast included in room rate (except private Cabin).
Lunches are $12-15
Dinners are $24-$28
Do we have the option to cook our own meals?
There is a shared kitchen in the Coffee House and you are welcome to prepare any of your own meals there.
Can you accommodate dietary restrictions?
Yes, we always have vegetarian options available. If you are gluten free or vegan or observe Halal or Kosher please let us know in advance.
GUIDING
You can explore the trails at MTCF on your own or with one of our expert certified guides.
Do I need to reserve guiding in advance?
You can arrange guiding when you arrive.
What do your guides specialize in?
Guides are specialized in birdwatching and all fauna categories with good knowledge of the ecology of the local cloud forest.
Do your guides speak english?
Yes
Guiding Fees:
Half day: $40 per person
Full day: $50 per person
(Please inquire for family rates)
ACCOMODATIONS & OTHER DETAILS
​
Do you take walk ins?
No. Our remote location and limited availability requires a reservation. Thank you!
Does MTCF provide laundry service?
Yes for a small fee
What type of Payment does MTCF take?
Visa & Master credit card or cash
Do you allow pets?
Unfortunately no pets are allowed at Mount Totumas with no exceptions.
SUGGESTED ATTIRE
What is the weather like at Mount Totumas?
Cool mornings down to 12 degree C (53 F) Mid day temperature around 28C (82F)
Do I need hiking boots?
Good walking shoes are fine during the dry season (Jan - May)
During our wet season (June - Dec) hiking boots or rubber boots are recommended.
What type of bugs / pests are at Mount Totumas?
No disease carrying insects. Dry season chiggers are present. Insect repellent available to spray on outer garments.
